title: Normalized section specialization for ordinary etale dualizing complexes over a Noetherian base
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $n\geq1$, and $A=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$. Let $S,V$ be Noetherian schemes (admitting finite affine open covers by spectra of Noetherian rings) on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $g:V\to S$ be a smooth separated morphism of finite type and pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $s:S\hookrightarrow V$ be a closed section, with ideal $\mathcal I$, and assume it is regular of codimension $d$: locally $\mathcal I=(x_1,\ldots,x_d)$, where multiplication by $x_i$ is injective on $\mathcal O_V/(x_1,\ldots,x_{i-1})$ for each $i$, and the quotient by all $x_i$ is $\mathcal O_S$. Its conormal sheaf $\mathcal E=\mathcal I/\mathcal I^2$ is locally free of rank $d$; put $\pi:N=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_S\operatorname{Sym}_{\mathcal O_S}(\mathcal E)\to S$ with zero section $z$ [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. Define $D=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_V\mathcal O_V[t,\mathcal I/t]$, where $\mathcal O_V[t,\mathcal I/t]$ is the subalgebra of $\mathcal O_V[t,t^{-1}]$ generated by $t$ and all $a/t$ for local sections $a\in\mathcal I$. Write $\widetilde g:D\to\mathbf A^1_S$ for its structural map [def-sbc-affine-space], and $\widetilde s:\mathbf A^1_S\to D$ for the section induced by $s^*\mathcal O_V\to\mathcal O_S$, $t\mapsto t$, and $\mathcal I/t\mapsto0$. Assume $g$, $\pi$, and $\widetilde g$ are compactifiable [def-asd-compactifiable]. Use only the ordinary unbounded derived categories of etale $A$-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and put $\omega_h=h^\times A_{\operatorname{target}(h)}$ using the ordinary compact-support adjoint [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. All inverse images are the exact constant-coefficient inverse images, extended to derived categories [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact].

The scheme $D$ is Noetherian, $\widetilde g$ is smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d$, and its pairs with section over $t=1$ and $t=0$ are canonically $(g,s)$ and $(\pi,z)$. Put $a:\mathbf A^1_S\to S$, $C=s^*\omega_g$, and $F=\widetilde s^*\omega_{\widetilde g}$. The complexes $C[-2d]$ and $F[-2d]$ are locally constant sheaves of free rank-one $A$-modules. Under the fibre identifications supplied by the canonical exceptional base-change maps [prop-asd-smooth-base-change], there is a unique isomorphism
$$\kappa_{g,s}:F\xrightarrow{\sim}a^*C$$
whose restriction at $t=1$ is $1_C$. In particular
$$\delta_{g,s}=(i_0^*\kappa_{g,s})^{-1}:s^*\omega_g\xrightarrow{\sim}z^*\omega_\pi,$$
where $i_0:S\to\mathbf A^1_S$ is $t=0$. For any morphism $S'\to S$ of Noetherian schemes for which the three base-changed maps are compactifiable, pullback carries $\kappa_{g,s}$ and $\delta_{g,s}$ to the respective normalized comparisons for the base-changed section, under the canonical exceptional base-change identifications.
